meta.note: The marquee across the top of every page. For upcoming exhibitions and showings.
The content warning shown over the archive before anyone can use it. Editable here because it is an ethical statement, not layout — it should not need a deploy to change.
Magic-link tokens. Hashed, single-use, short-lived. Written by the app; not for editing.
Live sign-ins. Deleting a row signs that person out immediately.
A content warning. On an archive of violence this is an ethical obligation, not a callout style.
Question and answer pairs. Each question gets its own anchor.
A group of supporter logos under a heading. Home page uses four of these.
A continuously scrolling row of names or logos. Used for supporters on the home page.

Named people with roles. Used twice on About, with different framing.
Prose. The workhorse block — Phase 2 base styles handle everything it emits.

The content warning shown over the experience logs — recordings of participants' sessions, which show the archive's material. Seeded as a copy of the archive's warning; reword it for what the recordings are.
The primary nav. Leave the list empty to fall back to the published page tree.
The page tree. Hierarchy is the self-referencing parent field.
Site identity and the default SEO/OG content used when a page does not set its own.
